businesses.business: life sciences reagents, instruments and diagnostics

offering_description.value: Develops and manufactures proteins, antibodies, assay kits and reagents, plus analytical instruments and spatial biology tools, for life science research and clinical labs. Also makes diagnostic controls and molecular diagnostic tests, sold to researchers, biopharma companies and clinical laboratories.

primary_products.value: recombinant proteins and antibodies; immunoassay kits; automated protein analysis instruments; spatial biology tools; diagnostic controls and reagents

primary_services.value: contract manufacturing of GMP proteins and cell therapy reagents; genomic and molecular diagnostic testing

customer_segment.value: B2B: academic and pharmaceutical researchers, biotech companies, clinical diagnostic laboratories, contract manufacturers; B2G: government and university research institutions

end_markets.value: biopharmaceutical research; academic research; clinical diagnostics; cell and gene therapy

revenue_model.value: product sales: reagents, kits, antibodies, proteins and instruments, with recurring consumables; service fees: contract manufacturing and diagnostic testing services

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: produces proteins, antibodies, reagents and instruments, sold to researchers, biopharma and clinical labs; service provider: contract development and manufacturing, plus diagnostic testing services

geography_served.value: global: North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific including China, and other regions

specialization.value: related lines: protein sciences reagents, diagnostics and genomics, spatial biology, and analytical instruments serving life science customers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: direct sales force to pharma, biotech and academic labs; online: e-commerce catalog ordering of reagents and kits; distributors / dealers: third-party distributors in international markets

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: FDA and international rules for diagnostics and GMP manufacturing, most products are research-use-only
